item.text: I’m untangling the repeated, shuffled instruction set and tracking the box labels separately from their contents; the label swap is the part that determines the final color names.

queries: "Follow all of these instructions" "brass key" "silver coin" "glass marble"

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "command -v ollama || true
command -v llama-cli || true
python3 -c \"import importlib.util; print([(x,bool(importlib.util.find_spec(x))) for x in ['transformers','torch','sentencepiece']])\""
